terms.definitionEn: A selector feature that matches an element according to its state or relationship.
terms.definitionAr: ميزة في الـ selector بتختار عنصر حسب حالته أو علاقته بعناصر تانية.

terms.definitionEn: A state selector that applies while a pointing device is over an element.
terms.definitionAr: selector حالة بيشتغل طول ما مؤشر جهاز التأشير فوق العنصر.

terms.definitionEn: A state selector used when the browser determines a visible focus indicator should be shown.
terms.definitionAr: selector حالة بيستخدم لما المتصفح يحدد إن مؤشر التركيز لازم يظهر.

terms.definitionEn: A structural selector that matches elements by their one-based position among siblings.
terms.definitionAr: selector تركيبي بيختار العناصر حسب ترتيبها ابتداءً من واحد بين الإخوة.

terms.definitionEn: A generated pseudo-element box placed at the start of an originating element's content.
terms.definitionAr: صندوق pseudo-element بيتولد في بداية محتوى العنصر الأصلي.

terms.definitionEn: A functional selector that excludes elements matching its argument selector.
terms.definitionAr: selector دالي بيستبعد العناصر اللي بتطابق الـ selector الموجود جواه.

terms.definitionEn: A selector group that accepts an item when any argument pattern fits.
terms.definitionAr: مجموعة selectors بتقبل العنصر لو أي نمط من اللي جواها انطبق.

terms.definitionEn: A generated pseudo-element box placed at the end of an originating element's content.
terms.definitionAr: صندوق pseudo-element بيتولد في نهاية محتوى العنصر الأصلي.

terms.definitionEn: A pseudo-element that targets hint text displayed inside a form control.
terms.definitionAr: pseudo-element بيختار نص الإرشاد اللي بيظهر جوه أداة النموذج.

terms.definitionEn: A property that supplies material for generated pseudo-element boxes.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتوفر مادة للصناديق المتولدة بواسطة pseudo-elements.

terms.definitionEn: A selector feature representing a styled part or generated box associated with an element.
terms.definitionAr: ميزة في الـ selector بتمثل جزء منسق أو صندوق متولد مرتبط بعنصر.

terms.definitionEn: A selector that uses an element's position or relationship within the document tree.
terms.definitionAr: selector حالة بيستخدم ترتيب العنصر أو علاقته داخل شجرة المستند.

questions.question: When does this rule match the link?
options: Only while it is being typed into
Whenever it is the first child
questions.explanation: The hover state applies while a pointing device is over the element, though other input methods may expose related states differently.
questions.explanationAr: حالة hover بتشتغل لما مؤشر جهاز التأشير يكون فوق العنصر.

questions.question: What does this selector help style?
options: Every button after it is clicked
Only buttons hovered by a pointer
questions.explanation: focus-visible lets the browser determine when a visible focus indicator should be shown.
questions.explanationAr: focus-visible بتسيب للمتصفح تحديد وقت إظهار مؤشر التركيز.

questions.question: Which list item is selected by this pattern?
options: Every second li regardless of siblings
The last li in the list
The li in sibling position two
The second li of each type only
questions.explanation: nth-child(2) selects an element in the second sibling position, regardless of its tag type.
questions.explanationAr: ‎nth-child(2) بتختار العنصر الموجود في الترتيب التاني بين الإخوة مهما كان نوعه.

questions.question: Where is this generated box placed?
options: Outside the document tree as a fixed layer
At the end of the link's content
At the start of the link's content
questions.explanation: The before pseudo-element is generated as the first child-like box of the originating element.
questions.explanationAr: pseudo-element بتاع before بيتولد كصندوق في بداية محتوى العنصر الأصلي.

questions.question: What text value does this rule supply to the generated box?
questions.explanation: The quoted string is the content value supplied to the pseudo-element.
questions.explanationAr: النص بين علامتي الاقتباس هو القيمة اللي بتتضاف للصندوق المتولد.

questions.prompt: Style the button while a pointing device is over it.
questions.explanation: The hover state is written after a colon.
questions.explanationAr: حالة hover بتتكتب بعد نقطتين.

questions.prompt: Select the second child in each matching parent.
questions.explanation: nth-child() selects by one-based sibling position.
questions.explanationAr: nth-child() بتختار حسب ترتيب العنصر بين الإخوة وبتبدأ من واحد.

questions.question: Which buttons match this rule?
options: Only buttons with the muted class
Buttons that are the first child
questions.explanation: The argument to not() is excluded, so buttons matching .muted are filtered out.
questions.explanationAr: العناصر اللي بتطابق .muted بتتستبعد من نتيجة not().

questions.question: Which headings match this grouped selector?
options: Only headings that contain other headings
questions.explanation: The functional selector matches an element if it matches any listed argument selector.
questions.explanationAr: الـ selector الدالي بيختار العنصر لو طابق أي selector من اللي جواه.

questions.question: Which item's text matches the selector?
questions.explanation: The second li is the second child in this list, so its text is B.
questions.explanationAr: عنصر li التاني هو الابن التاني في القائمة، فنصه B.

questions.prompt: Select h1, h2, or h3 with one forgiving selector group.
questions.explanation: is() groups selectors that can match any of its arguments.
questions.explanationAr: is() بتجمع selectors وبتختار اللي يطابق أي واحد من مدخلاتها.

questions.prompt: Insert a small arrow after each external link's text.
questions.explanation: The content property supplies the generated text.
questions.explanationAr: خاصية content بتوفر النص اللي هيتولد.

questions.question: What is needed for this pseudo-element to generate the arrow text?
options: A non-static position value on the link
An explicit width on every link
questions.explanation: A generated before or after box needs a content value other than none to be generated.
questions.explanationAr: صندوق before أو after محتاج قيمة content غير none عشان يتولد.

questions.prompt: Style placeholder hint text in an email input.
questions.explanation: The placeholder pseudo-element targets the control's placeholder text.
questions.explanationAr: pseudo-element بتاع placeholder بيختار نص الإرشاد داخل الأداة.

questions.question: Which text is targeted by this selector?
options: Every value entered by the user
questions.explanation: The placeholder pseudo-element styles placeholder text, not the entered value or associated label.
questions.explanationAr: الـ selector ده بينسق نص الإرشاد، مش القيمة المكتوبة أو الـ label.

questions.prompt: Show an outline when keyboard focus should be visibly indicated.
questions.explanation: focus-visible applies when the user-agent determines that a visible focus indicator should be shown.
questions.explanationAr: focus-visible بتشتغل لما المتصفح يقرر إن مؤشر التركيز لازم يظهر.

questions.question: What specificity tuple does the :is() argument contribute here?
questions.explanation: The ID argument gives :is() the greatest argument specificity, then the p type selector adds one type component.
questions.explanationAr: وسيط الـ ID بيدي is() أعلى specificity من مدخلاتها، وبعده selector النوع p بيضيف مكون نوع.

questions.question: How does the ID argument affect the specificity of this pattern?
options: It adds no specificity because it is negated
It changes the selector into an ID-only match
questions.explanation: The argument selector's specificity contributes to the specificity of :not().
questions.explanationAr: specificity بتاعة الـ selector اللي جوه :not() بتدخل في حساب القاعدة.

questions.prompt: Exclude buttons carrying the disabled class.
questions.explanation: not() filters out elements matching its argument selector.
questions.explanationAr: not() بتستبعد العناصر اللي بتطابق الـ selector الموجود جواها.

questions.prompt: Set the generated decoration text for the before box.
questions.explanation: content supplies generated text to the pseudo-element box.
questions.explanationAr: content بتوفر النص للصندوق المتولد.

questions.question: How can focus-visible improve keyboard accessibility?
keyPoints: It responds to focus state using browser heuristics
It supports a visible focus indicator
It can preserve pointer interactions without identical cues
Authors should not remove focus indication without replacement
questions.modelAnswer: focus-visible allows a visible indicator when the browser determines that it is useful, often for keyboard navigation. Provide a clear outline or other cue and avoid removing focus indication without an accessible replacement.
questions.explanation: A visible focus cue helps keyboard users locate the active control.
questions.explanationAr: مؤشر التركيز الواضح بيساعد مستخدم الكيبورد يعرف الأداة النشطة.

questions.question: What does nth-child() count, and how can its argument describe a pattern?
keyPoints: It accepts formulas such as odd or 2n
It is not restricted to siblings of the same tag
questions.modelAnswer: nth-child() counts an element's one-based position among all element siblings, not just elements of the same type. Its argument can be a number or a formula such as odd or 2n to describe a repeating pattern.
questions.explanation: The selector uses sibling position and supports arithmetic patterns.
questions.explanationAr: الاختيار بيعتمد على ترتيب الإخوة وبيسمح بصيغ حسابية لتحديد نمط.

questions.question: How do pseudo-elements and generated content work together?
keyPoints: Pseudo-elements represent generated boxes or parts
before and after need a content value to generate
Generated decoration should not carry essential information alone
The boxes belong to the originating element's rendering
questions.modelAnswer: Pseudo-elements such as before and after create boxes associated with an originating element, and the content property supplies generated text or other material. Use them for decoration rather than information users must receive only through generated text.
questions.explanation: Generated boxes are useful for decoration but should not replace meaningful content.
questions.explanationAr: الصناديق المتولدة مناسبة للزخرفة، لكن ما تعتمدش عليها وحدها لمعلومة أساسية.

questions.question: Compare :is() and :not() at a high level.
keyPoints: is() matches when an argument selector matches
not() excludes elements matching its argument
Their specificity includes argument specificity rules
questions.modelAnswer: is() groups alternatives and matches when an argument selector matches, while not() filters out elements matching its argument. Both are functional selectors whose specificity depends on their argument selectors rather than adding a simple fixed amount.
questions.explanation: The functions group or exclude matches and follow argument-based specificity rules.
questions.explanationAr: الأولى بتجمع بدائل، والتانية بتستبعد المطابق؛ والـ specificity بيتأثر بالمدخلات.
